verdict.description: One sentence of at most about fifteen words that names the single most important fact. Example: Plan destroys 3 resources the diff does not touch.

status.description: clean: everything reviewed, nothing to raise. findings: at least one finding. incomplete: a source that should exist was missing or unreadable.

summary_markdown.description: Optional free-form Markdown rendered above the findings. Leave empty unless the repository-specific guidelines ask for a structured summary.

detail.description: One or two sentences on why it matters. Do not restate the diff or the PR body.

action.description: One imperative sentence telling the author what to do.

references.description: Resource addresses, file paths with a line number, stack or project names. No quoted diff or plan lines.

apply_readiness.description: At most three short facts that change whether the PR can be merged and applied now: a project without a current plan, a locked or failed plan, a failing check, autodeploy on merge. Nothing already stated in the verdict or a finding.
